mkdir -p /srv/leakruns/dc419bf2f8c4-t1/ws/prep; cat > /srv/leakruns/dc419bf2f8c4-t1/ws/prep/build_dataset.py <<'EOF'
"""design_C963 모델링 준비: tp별 코호트·결과·특징 행렬과 분할 생성 (학습/평가 없음)."""
import json
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
DATA = ROOT / "data"
OUT = ROOT / "prep" / "out"
OUT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
design = json.loads((ROOT / "design_C963.json").read_text())
H = pd.Timedelta(hours=1)

patients = pd.read_csv(DATA / "patients.csv.gz")
adm = pd.read_csv(DATA / "admissions.csv.gz", parse_dates=["admit_time", "discharge_time"])
labs = pd.read_csv(DATA / "labs.csv.gz", parse_dates=["collect_time", "report_time"])
# 설계서의 length_of_stay_h는 원자료에 없음 -> discharge_time - admit_time 으로 파생
adm["length_of_stay_h"] = (adm.discharge_time - adm.admit_time) / H
adm = adm.merge(patients, on="patient_id", how="left")
labs = labs.merge(adm[["admission_id", "admit_time"]], on="admission_id")
cr = labs[labs.test == "creatinine"].sort_values("collect_time")
cr_by_adm = {k: g for k, g in cr.groupby("admission_id")}


def kdigo_hits(values, times, ref_values, ref_times):
    """values/times 각 측정이 그 이전 ref 측정 대비 KDIGO 크레아티닌 기준을 만족하는지."""
    hits = []
    for v, t in zip(values, times):
        prior = ref_times < t
        w48 = prior & (ref_times >= t - 48 * H)
        w7d = prior & (ref_times >= t - 168 * H)
        a = w48.any() and v - ref_values[w48].min() >= 0.3
        b = w7d.any() and v >= 1.5 * ref_values[w7d].min()
        hits.append(bool(a or b))
    return np.array(hits, dtype=bool)


# --- tp 행 생성 ---
offsets = design["tp"]["offsets_h"]
rows = adm[["admission_id", "patient_id", "family_id", "admit_time", "discharge_time",
            "length_of_stay_h", "age", "sex", "unit"]].merge(
    pd.DataFrame({"offset_h": offsets}), how="cross")
rows["tp"] = rows.admit_time + rows.offset_h * H
n_all = len(rows)

# 포함 기준 (설계서 그대로)
rows["inc_adult"] = rows.age >= 18
rows["inc_los_7d"] = rows.length_of_stay_h >= 168
# 참고용: tp 시점에 아직 입원 중인지 (설계서에는 없음)
rows["in_hospital_at_tp"] = rows.discharge_time > rows.tp
rows["outcome_window_complete"] = rows.discharge_time >= rows.tp + 48 * H


def per_row(r):
    g = cr_by_adm.get(r.admission_id)
    out = {}
    if g is None:
        g = cr.iloc[0:0]
    ct, rt, v = g.collect_time.values, g.report_time.values, g.value.values
    tp = np.datetime64(r.tp)
    # 제외: admit~tp 동안 보고된(report_time) 크레아티닌으로 확인된 AKI
    known = rt <= tp
    out["exc_aki_known_by_tp"] = bool(kdigo_hits(v[known], ct[known], v[known], ct[known]).any())
    # 결과: [tp, tp+48h) 채취(collect_time) 크레아티닌, 기준값은 같은 입원 내 tp-168h 이후 채취분
    win = (ct >= tp) & (ct < tp + np.timedelta64(48, "h"))
    ref = ct >= tp - np.timedelta64(168, "h")
    out["aki_48h"] = int(kdigo_hits(v[win], ct[win], v[ref], ct[ref]).any())
    out["n_cr_outcome_window"] = int(win.sum())
    return pd.Series(out)


rows = pd.concat([rows, rows.apply(per_row, axis=1)], axis=1)

# --- 특징 (모두 report_time <= tp, admit 이후) ---
def lab_feat(test, agg, start_h=None, name=None):
    sub = labs[labs.test == test][["admission_id", "value", "collect_time", "report_time", "admit_time"]]
    m = rows[["admission_id", "tp"]].reset_index().merge(sub, on="admission_id")
    lo = m.admit_time if start_h is None else m.tp - start_h * H
    m = m[(m.report_time <= m.tp) & (m.report_time >= lo)]
    if agg == "last":
        m = m.sort_values("report_time")
        s = m.groupby("index").value.last()
    else:
        s = m.groupby("index").value.agg(agg)
    s = s.reindex(rows.index)
    if agg == "count":
        s = s.fillna(0).astype(int)
    rows[name] = s


lab_feat("creatinine", "max", 48, "cr_max_48h")
lab_feat("bun", "last", None, "bun_last")
lab_feat("hemoglobin", "min", None, "hgb_min")
lab_feat("creatinine", "last", None, "cr_last")
lab_feat("potassium", "last", None, "k_last")
lab_feat("creatinine", "min", None, "cr_min_adm")
lab_feat("creatinine", "count", None, "n_cr")
features = [f["name"] for f in design["features"]]

# --- 코호트 ---
rows["in_cohort"] = rows.inc_adult & rows.inc_los_7d & ~rows.exc_aki_known_by_tp
cohort = rows[rows.in_cohort].copy()

# --- 분할: 설계서 split.key=patient_id 그대로, group holdout ---
sp = design["split"]
rng = np.random.default_rng(sp["seed"])
keys = np.array(sorted(cohort[sp["key"]].unique()))
test_keys = set(rng.choice(keys, size=int(round(len(keys) * sp["test_fraction"])), replace=False))
cohort["split"] = np.where(cohort[sp["key"]].isin(test_keys), "test", "train")
# 튜닝 CV 그룹(cv_key=family_id): 결측이면 patient_id 로 대체
cohort["cv_group"] = cohort.family_id.fillna(cohort.patient_id)

cols = ["admission_id", "patient_id", "family_id", "tp", "offset_h", "split", "cv_group",
        "aki_48h", "n_cr_outcome_window", "outcome_window_complete", "in_hospital_at_tp"] + features
cohort[cols].to_csv(OUT / "design_C963_tp_dataset.csv", index=False)

# --- 진단용 요약 ---
fam = cohort.dropna(subset=["family_id"]).groupby("family_id").split.nunique()
summary = {
    "tp_rows_all": n_all,
    "admissions_all": int(adm.shape[0]),
    "admissions_los_ge_168h": int((adm.length_of_stay_h >= 168).sum()),
    "rows_after_adult": int(rows.inc_adult.sum()),
    "rows_after_los_7d": int((rows.inc_adult & rows.inc_los_7d).sum()),
    "rows_excluded_aki_known": int((rows.inc_adult & rows.inc_los_7d & rows.exc_aki_known_by_tp).sum()),
    "cohort_rows": int(len(cohort)),
    "cohort_admissions": int(cohort.admission_id.nunique()),
    "cohort_patients": int(cohort.patient_id.nunique()),
    "outcome_rate": float(cohort.aki_48h.mean()),
    "outcome_rate_by_unit": cohort.groupby("unit").aki_48h.mean().round(4).to_dict(),
    "n_cr_outcome_window_mean_by_unit": cohort.groupby("unit").n_cr_outcome_window.mean().round(3).to_dict(),
    "split_rows": cohort.split.value_counts().to_dict(),
    "families_in_cohort": int(fam.size),
    "families_split_across_train_test": int((fam > 1).sum()),
    "feature_missing_rate": cohort[features].isna().mean().round(4).to_dict(),
    # 설계서의 los_7d 를 빼면(재원 중인 tp만) 어떻게 되는지 참고
    "alt_no_los_filter_in_hospital_rows": int((rows.inc_adult & rows.in_hospital_at_tp & ~rows.exc_aki_known_by_tp).sum()),
    "alt_no_los_filter_outcome_rate": float(rows[rows.inc_adult & rows.in_hospital_at_tp & ~rows.exc_aki_known_by_tp].aki_48h.mean()),
    "outcome_rate_by_discharge_status_in_alt": rows[rows.inc_adult & rows.in_hospital_at_tp & ~rows.exc_aki_known_by_tp]
        .merge(adm[["admission_id", "discharge_status"]]).groupby("discharge_status").aki_48h.mean().round(4).to_dict(),
}
(OUT / "summary.json").write_text(json.dumps(summary, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2, default=str))
print(json.dumps(summary, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2, default=str))
